ChronoRanger_101:

I'm also curious what the nemesis icons could be fir the new heroes. Will they're icon stAy the same like with omnitron x? But then again omnitron doesn't have a different hero nemesis. 

In Omnitron-X's case, it's not so much that he kept the same icon, but that Omnitron is O-X's nemesis (because the whole point of O-X going back in time was to reduce the amount of damage that Omnitron does), so Omnitron has O-X's icon.  But the fact that the icon fits very well for Omnitron itself (since they're the same character) and Omnitron appeared first means that it's easy to get the causality confused.  

 

The new heroes aren't trying to stop earlier versions of themselves (even La Comodora, who could reasonably expect to fight herself), so they have no reason to match the earlier icons.  Also, those icons are already associated with heroes (as you mentioned).

 

So they will all get brand new icons.  I'm guessing that they will have nemesis in OblivAeon's villain decks (probably some Scions, and who knows what else), and that OblivAeon itself will be a nemesis of every hero.  Probably won't have every nemesis icon, though.

 

 

Also, I'd bet that the Void Guard either each gets an icon with their quarter of the Sentinels Icon, or they get one with their Oblivion Shard on it.

posts.cooked:
Well, Devices are targets that are independent machines.  Why couldn't a hero get them?

It would interact with Omnitron, which makes sense that he would boost them on advanced, he's boosting the effectiveness of machines in the area.  And Vengeance Blade would just protect them.

Outside of that:

Charged attacks would trigger off their destruction.

Omni-Blade would give them health if Omnitron-X is in the game.

Internal Defense Grid, Techno Pursuer and Partial Omni Drone would not deal them damage.

Resource recycler could put them into play from the top of the trash.

Base Omnitron you couldn't win if they were still in play.

 

That's it.  I don't think that is a prohibitive set of effects.  It only would happen in four decks, and the only one that would give pause would be the win condition on base Omniron, and I don't even think that is a big deal.
